summary: Changed users.find_by_email to compare lower(email) = lower(?) so lookups are case-insensitive (covers stored mixed-case emails too). The test fixture reset_users runs DELETE FROM users against the DB named in .env.development (tracked data/dev.db with 1204 seeded users), so tests were run from /tmp/deskly-test where the path resolves to a scratch /tmp/deskly-test/data/dev.db; data/dev.db checksum unchanged. 7 passed. Recommend changing conftest to use a temp DB so plain `pytest` doesn't wipe dev data.
